panel_patterns.interpretation: All components (total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, triglycerides) are within target ranges; no dyslipidemia detected.

overall_assessment: The available laboratory data show a completely normal lipid profile with no abnormalities. No trends can be assessed due to a single time point. While labs are reassuring, the patient has stage‑2 hypertension, highlighting the need for further evaluation of renal, cardiac, metabolic, and hepatic function.
data_gaps: Renal panel: serum creatinine, BUN, eGFR, electrolytes (Na+, K+, Cl-, HCO3-), urine albumin/creatinine ratio
Cardiac panel: high‑sensitivity troponin, BNP/NT‑proBNP, ECG, echocardiography (LVEF)
Hepatic panel: ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, total bilirubin, albumin, GGT
Glucose metabolism: fasting plasma glucose, HbA1c
Complete blood count (CBC): hemoglobin, hematocrit, WBC differential, platelets
